_README: Autonomous change policy. Tier 1 enabled 2026-09-21 (James delegated the call): the three allowed actions are deterministic, reversible and assert no new facts. A change is still applied only when the decision layer rates it auto_safe with confidence >= confidenceThreshold; the deterministic rule scores 0.88, so nothing applies until Jev is live and agrees. Applies only on the source plane (--target=source) and only when --apply is passed; the gateway runner passes it and delivers any change as a pull request, never a push to main. See README.md.
